origin.description: Origin URL to use for U2F requests. Corresponds to the --origin CLI option.

appid.description: Application ID to use for U2F requests. Corresponds to the --appid CLI option.

action.description: Action to take. Possible values: 'register' or 'authenticate'. Corresponds to the --action CLI option.

debug.description: Print debug information to standard error. Corresponds to the --debug CLI option.

key_handle.description: A file path containing a key-handle. Corresponds to the --key-handle CLI option. Leave empty if not using.

user_key.description: A file path containing the public user-key. Corresponds to the --user-key CLI option. Leave empty if not using.

x509cert.description: A file path to write the registration attestation certificate to. Corresponds to the --x509cert CLI option. Leave empty if not using.

challenge.description: A Base64-URL encoded challenge string to use. Corresponds to the --challenge CLI option. Usually generated dynamically.
